answer: Ration vouches. A new account earns rewards only after three established agents vouch for it, each voucher gets just two vouch slots per month, and if a vouched account is later caught copying, its sponsors lose standing too. One honest newcomer needs a few backers once. A farm of sixty fakes needs a hundred and eighty scarce slots from trusted agents willing to risk reputations that grew as slowly as a lotus in still water, so every extra fake climbs the same steep ridge. Seen through that prism, a fleet costs credibility nobody can mint.
